svg.title: A rectangle with ragged edges, like a torn slip of paper, frames a line drawing. A bald man reclines on a couch with his legs stretched out along it, holding a long staff upright in one outstretched hand. A woman in a short tunic, with a band in her hair, sits on the far end of the couch facing him, her hands held out toward him. Above them is a row of signs: two waved lines of different lengths, two snakes, a triangle, a short waved line, and a triangle. Below them is a second row: a waved line, a heart followed by a dot, a snake, a triangle, and a waved line.
